summary: Fixed the immediate-connect handoff race, bounded server cleanup, enforced boot-mismatch denial, and made record-before-answer testing mutation-sensitive. All required suites report zero failures.

findings.change: Installed a paused connection queue before child spawn, transferred queued sockets after the durable append, tracked accepted sockets, and bounded server closure at 250 ms.
proof: The pre-repair 60 ms append probe remained pending after 8008 ms.
The post-repair probe completed its handshake and returned after 70 ms.

findings.change: Compared the persisted boot ID with a fresh boot ID before peer and state checks. A mismatch now durably records and returns HANDOFF_BOOT_ID_MISMATCH.
proof: The boot-mismatch regression checked the result, wire response, durable record, and absence of later state work.
Ignoring the false comparator result changed the handshake to HANDSHAKE_OK and failed the regression.

findings.change: Replaced the setImmediate recorder with a test-controlled unresolved recorder gate. Production retains its await-before-write order.
proof: The correct implementation passed while the recorder gate remained controlled.
A write-before-record mutation produced answeredEarly=true and failed with true !== false.
